correctness.rationale: Binary synchronous threshold-one firing translates the four-point support each round, with distinct translates over a period by its gap word. Label the local positions A,B,C,D at time t by offsets 0,1,m−1,m. A subset of the new facet is in an earlier facet iff its vertices have a common positive backward lag r≤t. The four possible-lag sets on 1≤r<2m are {1,m−1,m}, {m−2,m−1,2m−1}, {1,m+1,m+2}, {m,m+1,2m−1}. Thus the first lags for AB,AC,AD,BD,CD are m−1,1,m,2m−1,m+1, with BC absent and no triple intersection, for every m≥4. Singleton lags give exactly the extra B vertex at t=m−2. This independently proves the complete attachment table. The homotopy cofibre of an edge or tree inclusion preserves the previous homotopy type; an edge plus isolated point over the contractible stage gives a circle. For t=m+j the loop is coned from m+j−1 in the earlier facets F_{j−1}, F_j and F_{m+j−1}. The last extra loop also cones, from m using F_0, F_{m−1}, F_m. For the connected final graph the two coned loops generate its fundamental group, hence the inclusion is nullhomotopic. Each such cofibre wedges on the suspension of the attaching graph, giving one sphere per intermediate birth and two at the terminal round. Integral Mayer–Vietoris gives split inclusions with free quotients (one H_1 generator at m−2 and the stated H_2 increments); the spaces stay connected and the filtration then stabilizes. Compatible bases give the asserted essential interval modules, integrally, not just over a field.
residual_risks: The supplied barcode diagnostic is mod two and its supplied output is recorded/expected, not an independently executed integral computation. The integral conclusion rests on the split-map proof. The analysis concerns this synchronous directed cycle only.

value.rationale: The support is the natural antipodal boundary of the two-pair cycle family, not an arbitrary small sample. The exact time filtration detects facts that the known terminal wedge cannot: the loop first forms at m−2, two-dimensional classes start later, all survive integrally, and two independent births occur in the last round. This provides a scalable worked boundary case for avalanche persistence. The terminal wedge on its own is not credited as new value.
residual_risks: The result is specialized to this boundary support and does not claim a classification for arbitrary four-grain orbits or nonbinary firing.
